fields.name: vptr
fields.evidence: the constructor (inlined in the fighter accessor builder 0x7100573780) stores the class vptr

fields.name: owner_boma
fields.evidence: the constructor stores the accessor being built (the one whose +0xd0 receives this module); every method reaches its own object id (boma+0x8) and sibling modules (boma+0x38 posture, +0x78 model, +0x88 motion...) through it; get_parent_object_id_motion_transactor_link returns boma id when 0x140 is -1

fields.name: link_record_count
fields.evidence: the initialise method (vtable slot 0x28) copies a {count, array} pair from its argument into 0x10/0x18 and loops 0..count over the records

fields.name: link_records
fields.evidence: array of 0x68-byte per-link-number records indexed by link_no (link, unlink, is_link(no), get_parent_* all compute records + no*0x68); see pointers

fields.name: node_list_head
fields.evidence: intrusive list of the objects linked to me (children/nodes): is_linked, search_node, get_node_object_id, unlink_node, is_node_damage_reaction, get_node_scale walk it; item +0 next, +0x10 object id, +0x18 link record (+0x64 link no), +0x20 the node's LinkModule

fields.name: node_list_tail
fields.evidence: zeroed with 0x20 as a 16-byte pair in initialise; head/tail/count layout

fields.name: node_count
fields.evidence: is_linked with link_no -1 returns count != 0; every node-list walk tests it first

fields.name: parent_list_head
fields.evidence: intrusive list of my links to parents: search_parent (item+0x10 = parent id), search_parent_attr, chk_link_stop, is_valid_link_stop, unlink_all, get_parent_power_up_* walk it; item+0x18 = my link record, item+0x20 = the parent's LinkModule

fields.name: parent_list_tail
fields.evidence: zeroed with 0x38 as a pair in initialise

fields.name: parent_count
fields.evidence: is_link with link_no -1 returns count != 0; unlink_all loops unlinking until it is 0

fields.name: manager_list_next
fields.evidence: vtable slots 0x38/0x40 insert/remove the node at module+0x50 in a global list (manager pointer at 0x71052B8808, its count at +0x18)

fields.name: manager_list_prev
fields.evidence: same insert/remove code; prev pointer of the node at 0x50

fields.name: manager_list_owner
fields.evidence: initialise stores the module's own address here (owner of the 0x50 list node)

fields.name: last_constraint_matrix
fields.how: computed: recomputes the constraint matrix and returns true if any of the 4 rows differs from the stored one
fields.evidence: constructor sets identity; is_change_model_constraint_matrix compares rows 0x70/0x80/0x90/0xa0; non-exported slot 0x3d8 stores the freshly computed matrix here when its bool is true; set_model_constraint_target_joint writes FLT_MAX into element [0][0] to force a change

fields.name: model_constraint_link_no
fields.evidence: get_model_constraint_no returns it; is_model_constraint = (value != -1); set_model_constraint_pos_ort writes the link_no; remove_model_constraint and initialise reset it to -1; get_link_speed and the constraint position getters index link_records with it

fields.name: model_constraint_joint
fields.evidence: get_model_constraint_joint returns it; set_model_constraint_joint stores it; initial value hash40 invalid (0x7fb997a80)

fields.name: model_constraint_target_joint
fields.evidence: get_model_constraint_target_joint returns it; set_model_constraint_target_joint stores it; get_model_constraint_target_node_position and target_joint_rotation pass it to the parent's ModelModule; initial hash40 invalid

fields.name: linked_attribute_mask
fields.how: bit attr (returns bit 1<<attr of this word)
fields.evidence: rebuilt as the OR of record+0x60 over the node list (unlink_node, set_attribute, set_model_constraint_attribute); zeroed by unlink_node_all; the getter is a plain load and bit test, but the field is a derived cache

fields.name: link_attribute_mask
fields.how: bit attr gates the answer; the result is bit attr of the record's own mask (record+0x60)
fields.evidence: rebuilt by 0x71004896c0 as the OR of record+0x60 over the parent list; zeroed by unlink_all. Bits used: 0 link stop (chk_link_stop, is_valid_link_stop), 2 link scale (get_link_scale), 7 visibility (chk_link_visibility), 8 constraint model scale (byte 0xcd bit 0, get_constraint_model_scale), 17 power up (is_link_power_up, byte 0xce bit 1), 22 node attack (is_link_node_attack returns byte 0xce bit 6 directly)

fields.name: constraint_rot_offset
fields.how: set_constraint_rot_offset and its _x/_y/_z variants store degrees*0.0174533 (radians) per lane, w=0
fields.evidence: the four rot-offset setters write lanes of 0xd0 then notify the ModelModule; set_model_constraint_pos_ort resets 0xd0/0xe0/0xf0 to a global vector constant

fields.name: constraint_scale_offset
fields.evidence: set_constraint_scale_offset writes 0xe0

fields.name: constraint_translate_offset
fields.evidence: get_constraint_translate_offset returns the vector at 0xf0; set_constraint_translate_offset writes it

fields.name: fixed_constraint_matrix
fields.how: copied out whole by the per-frame constraint-matrix method in one branch
fields.evidence: constructor and initialise set identity; non-exported slot 0x418 copies 0x100..0x13f to its output matrix; no exported writer found

fields.name: motion_transactor_link_object_id
fields.how: computed: if -1 returns the own boma id, else resolves it through slot 0x1b8
fields.evidence: initial -1; non-exported setter slot 0x440 stores it; also read by non-exported slots 0x240/0x250/0x260

fields.name: model_constraint_flag
fields.evidence: get_model_constraint_flag returns it; set_model_constraint_flag stores it; off_model_constraint_flag clears bits; is_link_pos and update_link_pos require bit 4 (and 0x1000) off and a bit of 0x9 on; remove_model_constraint zeroes it

fields.name: model_constraint_mutual
fields.evidence: is_model_constraint_mutual returns the byte; set_model_constraint_pos_ort sets it when the parent's own constraint target is this object

fields.name: unknown_node_rot_suppress
fields.evidence: slot 0x530 stores (arg&1); slot 0x528 skips a node's slot-0x528 call when it is set

pointers.to: array[link_record_count] of 0x68-byte LinkRecord: +0x10 list item (next, prev, +0x20 u32 object id, +0x28 self, +0x30 LinkModule) used in the parent's node list; +0x38 second item (+0x48 u32 parent object id, +0x50 self, +0x58 parent's LinkModule) used in my parent list; +0x60 u32 LinkAttribute mask; +0x64 u8 link_no; +0x65 u8 linked
node list items (+0 next, +8 prev, +0x10 object id, +0x18 LinkRecord, +0x20 node's LinkModule)
parent list items (same item layout; +0x20 = parent's LinkModule)

notes: Single class (0x7104f6f6d8, 336 bytes). The constructor is inlined in the fighter accessor builder 0x7100573780; initialise is vtable slot 0x28 (0x710047ee20). Null-slot exports resolve through the vtable: get_parent_id 0x80 (returns 0x50000000 if not linked, else record+0x48 or, with the bool, the parent boma id), get_parent_model_joint_global_position 0x160, ..._rotation 0x170, send_event_nodes_throw 0xc8, set_node_link_scale 0x208, set_parent_hit_stop_frame 0x2e8, set_model_constraint_pos_ort 0x358, set_model_constraint_attribute 0x360 (toggles mask 0x01A0608B in record+0x60), remove_model_constraint 0x3c0, set_attribute 0x428 (toggles 1<<attr in record+0x60, rebuilds 0xc8 of self and parent and 0xcc), set_unreference_parent_scale 0x508 (empty for this class). get_parent_* forward to the parent's modules through record[link_no]+0x58 -> LinkModule+0x8 -> boma (posture 0x38, status 0x40, motion 0x88, damage 0xa8, kinetic 0x68, color 0x70, model 0x78...). Most getters return fallbacks (1.0 scale, id 0x50000000, 0) when no matching link is found. Not traced: the internals of the per-frame constraint method (slot 0x418).
